name: @refarm.dev/scarecrow-plugin
description: Sandboxed host-effect observer (WASM): declares observe-host-effects, records every fs/shell effect with a risk verdict — the governor is itself the least-privileged extension.

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/ci/cargo-run.mjs --copy wasm32-wasip1/release/scarecrow_plugin.wasm dist/plugin.wasm component build --target wasm32-wasip1 --release && node scripts/write-plugin-manifest.mjs
scripts.build:wasm: node ../../scripts/ci/cargo-run.mjs --copy wasm32-wasip1/release/scarecrow_plugin.wasm dist/plugin.wasm component build --target wasm32-wasip1 --release && node scripts/write-plugin-manifest.mjs
